FN-V26XLPP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 231
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 231 as introduced proposes a constitutional amendment which, if ratified, could
reduce funding to local public K-12 boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent
on the amount of funds that are withheld for failure to recite the Pledge of Allegiance and a
Judeo-Christian prayer as provided by this bill.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
Page 1

FN-V26XLPP-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 231
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/16/2025
House Bill 231 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy proposes a constitutional
amendment which, if ratified, could reduce funding to local public K-12 boards of education by
an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of funds that are withheld for failure to recite
the Pledge of Allegiance and fail to vote on a policy that would provide an opportunity for a
period of prayer and reading of the Bible or other religious text as provided by this bill.
Additionally, this bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the
State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2027.
